name: HÅRMONIOUS70 × STEAM SANS — Applicable Harmony Style Sheet
instruction: Use this file as an agentic interior-design grammar. Select tokens by scene, register, and resonance state. The interface behaves as a living room of attention: each object earns its place, each transition carries breath, each surface holds reflection.

sourcePrinciples.vesselverse: Locate the human coordinate. Name the mechanism. Deepen with the term. Return with usable recognition.
sourcePrinciples.harmonious70: 70mm scale, monochromatic nuance, reflective intelligence, elemental calm, inclusive human presence, conceptual realism, dynamic stillness.
sourcePrinciples.steamSans: A typographic instrument with three experiential registers: Harris as stable instrument, HBA as witnessing breath, Vapor as transmission and dissolution.
sourcePrinciples.applicableHarmony: A proportional system translating resonance into usable spacing, motion, interface pressure, and scene mood. Its EQ remains experiential. It is felt through measure.

sceneShift.day: A warm reflective atelier. Stone, paper, morning air, visible grain, high legibility, generosity of space.
sceneShift.night: A cinematic sanctuary. Black moss, indigo hush, gold signal, reflective glass, slow breathing interface.

glyphButton.gesture: press, hover, focus, and linger all change atmospheric pressure
